feedback: Approving the candidate as submitted. It is the iteration 10 design (mass 0.6, all other fields as iteration 7), and no earlier race has beaten it. Iteration 10 scored 700.0, up from 687.1 in iteration 7. Its oval finished 20/20 (max_error 0.008) and its s-bend finished 20/20 (steering_oscillation 0.31). The slalom still ends off track in every run (progress 0.52, max_error 0.065, 1.35 line-loss events), so it remains the binding track. Earlier races rule out the other levers: kp 4.0 (iteration 5, slalom progress down), kd 0.7 (iteration 3 vs 4, slalom progress down), base_speed 1.2 (iteration 2, cost on oval and s-bend), wider or narrower lateral spacing (iterations 6 and 9), and the 16 mm footprint (iteration 8, neutral). Mass 0.5 is the untested next step, but this is the final iteration and an unapproved build scores 0. Mass 0.5 carries an unmeasured risk to the oval and s-bend, so it is not worth that exposure now. Do not change any field before the race.
requested_changes: No change before the race: keep mass 0.6, kp 3.8, kd 0.8, ki 0, base_speed 1.3, line_loss last_direction and the current geometry, since iteration 10 is the best measured result (700.0).

If another build is ever produced in a future race, test mass 0.5 as the single change, using iteration 10 as the fallback, as iteration 10's own telemetry (slalom progress up from 0.45 to 0.52) suggests that lower inertia is the direction that helps.
